response.justification: Bogdan is a highly accomplished senior/staff engineer with 15+ years of experience, a CS degree, and strong agile/craftsmanship practices, but he is a poor fit for an entry-level Java developer position. His Java exposure is dated and peripheral (2016–2018 at Altom), with his core expertise in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms. Most critically, the role requires strong verbal and written German, and he lists German as basic. The seniority mismatch also raises significant flight-risk and compensation-alignment concerns for a junior IC role in insurance consulting.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and cloud
Strong agile/TDD/CI-CD craftsmanship and mentoring/teaching track record
CS degree, Berlin-based, and demonstrable OOP and architecture capability
concerns: German only at basic level; role requires professional German fluency
Java experience is minimal and roughly a decade out of date
Severely overqualified for an entry-level position (retention/comp risk)
